text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-8432 — capacity_exhaustion on service=inference-queue-prod. queuesize > 4500, 5xx spike, autoscaler lagging. Priority: P1. Please ack.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-8432 assigned to @emma (oncall). Trigger: queue_backlog_threshold.

emma (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Any immediate customer reports?

raj: seeing elevated latencies in the dashboards — median rtt for inference-api up from 120ms -> 800ms last 5m. Error rate ~3.2%.

liam: autoscaler metrics show desired_replicas = 40, current_replicas = 22 for pool=inference-gpu-pool-a. scale_up events queued but controller backoff exists.

carmen: pinging the controller logs now, might be hitting kube API rate limits.

emma (oncall): ok runbook step 1: set incident priority, notify product ops, and attempt manual scale to bridge while we fix autoscaler.

mara: @emma pushed timeline to product-ops. product-ops acknowledged, prepping customer comms if we need a mitigation note.

emma (oncall): Running manual scale now: kubectl scale --replicas=40 deploy/inference-worker -n prod. Posting logs...

ops-bot: Executing: kubectl scale --replicas=40 deploy/inference-worker -n prod
ops-bot: Result: accepted by API server, rollout started.

liam: rollout is stuck at 22/40 pods becoming Ready; many pods crashloop with image pull ok but failing readiness: OOM? checking pod logs.

raj: pod logs show repeated crash: GPU OOM on startup for model shard allocation. Looks like recent model variant has larger KV footprint — memory pressure causing OOM during init.

emma (oncall): hmm, we rolled model-canary last night to inference-worker image v2.4. Reverting to v2.3 might help while we investigate.

alex: I can push a rollback if you want. Command: kubectl set image deploy/inference-worker inference-worker=redwood/inference-worker:v2.3 -n prod && kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n prod

emma (oncall): Do it. We need pods in Ready state to clear queue.

ops-bot: Executing: kubectl set image deploy/inference-worker inference-worker=redwood/inference-worker:v2.3 -n prod && kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n prod

ops-bot: Rollout started for deploy/inference-worker.

liam: new pods coming up on v2.3. Ready count incrementing 22 -> 29 -> 35 in last 4 minutes. queue depth falling from 4.6k -> 1.1k. 5xx rate down to 1.1%.

carmen: autoscaler heartbeats still showing backoff state; controller logs include HTTP 429 from cloud provider on node provisioning calls — quota/provisioning throttle. Escalating infra quota with cloud team.

emma (oncall): Good containment. For now we have partial mitigation via rollback. Can we enable fallback routing to inference-fallback-slim model for queued requests to avoid future OOMs? That reduces quality but keeps latency low.

raj: I can toggle routing: update route table inference-api -> if queue_length > 1000 then route 40% traffic to inference-fallback-slim. Deploying rule now.

ops-bot: Route rule applied: fallback routing enabled. Current split: primary 60% / fallback 40%.

mara: product-ops: drafting short customer note about transient degraded quality/latency while we remediate. ETA 30m for full stabilization.

emma (oncall): Confirming incident state: partial mitigation in place (rollback + fallback routing). No major customer-facing outages, some degraded responses for certain requests. Marking P1 -> monitoring for 60m before reducing priority.

alex: cloud support replied: provisioning throttled due to API rate limits; asked to open a support ticket for capacity bump. I've opened ticket SUP-5921. They estimate 2-3 hours for quota adjustment.

liam: suggestion: add a short-term horizontal node pool of smaller GPU instances to absorb pod churn while quota resolves. However new instance types need AMI bake — time cost ~45m.

carmen: for RCA later: track model-canary memory diff and gating in rollout pipeline. There's no current preflight that simulates cold-KV load.

emma (oncall): Agreed. Action items: 1) Follow cloud ticket SUP-5921 (alex). 2) Add gating test for KV cold start in rollout (carmen + raj). 3) Short postmortem + timeline (emma). 4) Customer follow-up (product-ops + mara).

product-ops: Customer note sent to top 20 usage accounts, links to status page and ETA.

liam: queue depth stabilized ~800 and trending down. Autoscaler still in backoff but rollout rollback removed OOM source so we should be able to scale when quota lifts.

emma (oncall): I'll keep this thread live until metrics are back to baseline and cloud ticket has an update. If anything changes ping @emma.

pagerduty: PD-INC-8432 status: acknowledged by emma. No escalation at this time.

ops-bot: Incident log snippet saved to /incidents/PD-INC-8432/1768888888.log

emma (oncall): closing loop for now — switching to monitoring state. Last check: 5xx < 0.5%, queue < 500, median latency ~140ms. Will file full postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

mara: thanks — saving action items into the incident board.

alex: noted for follow-up on quota and short-term pool feasibility.

carmen: will start on rollout preflight spec tomorrow.

emma (oncall): closing thread in 15m if no regression.

pagerduty: PD-INC-8432 resolved by user emma (oncall).
